    BOOK NOW!

    Founded in 2017 with the aim to provide visitors and locals with a relaxing spa experience, Orient Spa Hanoi currently operates 4 spas all in the heart of Hanoi Old Quarter.
    We offer foot and body massage, nails care and shampoo, as well as spa packages.
    Our spa is open from 10:00am - 10:00pm daily. Advanced reservation is recommended especially during weekend.

    Why Choose Orient spa Hanoi?

    Visit Orient Spa Hanoi and take a heavenly break from your daily routine or pamper yourself nicely after a long trip.

    Perfect for couples, groups,
    and solo travelers

    Whether you're traveling alone, or on a honeymoon, or even with young kids, we always have something to offer.

    Convenient and central location

    All our spas are just a short walk from major attractions of Hanoi such as Hoan Kiem Lake and Saint Joseph Cathedral.

    Skilled therapists
    and attentive receptionists

    Be warmly welcomed and expertly cared for by friendly staff from start to finish.
